answer: What survives to the harbor is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, re-queued for a second panel, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Work waits on the relic until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the tundra of the next round.
